text:
The flesh covers the bone

and inside they put

a brain and

sometimes a soul,

and women throw

vases against the walls

and men drink

too much and nobody finds the other

but they keep

looking

from bed

to bed.

The flesh covers

the bone and the

flesh looks for

something more than

flesh.

There is no

possibility:

we are all trapped

by a singular

fate.

Nobody ever finds

the other.

The slums fill up

the dumps fill up

the madhouses fill up

the hospitals fill up

the graves fill up

nothing else fills up.

translation.title: Alone with Everybody
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the flesh/bone refrain and the bleak inventory of places filling up.
